title: Switch Case
text: Select subsystem execution using logic similar to switch statement, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough; {Case conditions} sets the case values, {Show default case} controls display of default output port and {Enable zero-crossing detection} controls zero-crossing detection. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: case
ports.summary: Action signal for a Switch Case Action Subsystem block scalar

params.name: Case conditions
params.values: Specify case values {1} (default) | list of cases

params.name: Show default case
params.values: Control display of default output port on (default) | off
